description: This Java class is an abstract base implementation for building headers (likely HTTP or application-specific headers) within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes header validation, setting, removal, and building mechanisms, and handles various header types such as metadata, content type, authorization, and response controls.

classes.name: AbstractDittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: An abstract base class for constructing and validating headers within the Eclipse Ditto framework, supporting method chaining and handling various header types including metadata, content type, authorization, and response control. It enforces validation, supports building immutable header representations, and manages internal header maps.
